fact: On 14 October 2021 the Minister of Interior inaugurated the WAPIS Data Collection and Registration Centre at the Joint Operation Center in Banjul; the programme is funded by the European Union under ECOWAS and implemented by INTERPOL under an MoU signed 19 January 2019, 40 workstations had been installed in the capital area at Police, Immigration and DLEA premises with 72 persons trained, and the EU Ambassador urged a national budget heading for running the centre by the start of 2022.
title: ECOWAS Strengthens Its Security Architecture With The Inauguration Of The WAPIS Centre In Gambia
